summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The EA Bridgeway Aggressive Investors ETF (BAGX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that uses a statistical investment approach to invest in US-listed companies across all market capitalizations. The fund seeks long-term total return on capital, primarily through capital appreciation. BAGX was launched on Jul 24, 2026 and is issued by Alpha Architect.

holdings.infoBox: BAGX is an equity ETF with a total of 96 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 5.42%, Apple at 4.73%, Alphabet at 4.14%, Microsoft at 3.79%, and Micron Technology at 2.20%.
